IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Financial Institutions, Housing & Consumer Protection.

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring lenders to consider retail installment contracts for the purchase of motor vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to retail installment contracts for motor vehicles;and adding a new section to chapter 63.14 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 63.14 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a retail installment contract for the purchase of a motorvehicle meets the requirements of this chapter and contains informationrequired by federal law to be disclosed in a retail installmentcontract for the purchase of a motor vehicle, the retail installmentcontract shall be accepted for consideration by any lender, except forlenders licensed and regulated under the provisions of chapter 31.04RCW, to whom application is made for credit relating to the retailinstallment contract.
